items.text:
This week, Trump and Republicans shut down the government and caused healthcare premiums to soar for millions of Americans.

Now, in an act of political act of retribution, they are canceling over $7.5 BILLION in energy projects across the country – including over $1.2 billion in California.

This Administration is hurting families and harming our communities' health to appease their billionaire donors.

https://t.co/cnAt7rj9LA

What is the Republicans' agenda to help working families?

🛑 Shutdown the Government 
❌ Cancel votes in the House
🌴 Go on vacation for 15 days

Meanwhile, @HouseDemocrats are fighting to keep healthcare affordable and reopen the government. 

Speaker Johnson needs to act now and bring up a bipartisan deal for working families, NOT billionaires.

The impact of Republicans' shutdown is being felt by health organizations who serve working families across the San Fernando Valley.

I met with many of them at the Valley Care Community Consortium at CSUN where I heard about how Republicans' healthcare crisis and their shutdown is impacting healthcare in our communities.

Republicans need to quit playing games and come to the table and protect healthcare for our working families.

Some quick reminders to start the week:

❌ Republicans have been on vacation for 18 days – including 6 of a government shutdown

❌ Republicans are still refusing to work with Democrats on fixing the healthcare crisis THEY manufactured

❌ Republicans have control of the House, Senate, and White House

This is their shutdown.

While Republicans are going on day 19 of vacation, I am in DC working to re-open the government and fighting to keep your healthcare from being taken away. 

Join me for a telephone town hall TOMORROW, October 8 at 5:30 pm PST to talk about this Republican government shutdown and its impact on our community.

CA-29 residents can register at the link in my bio to receive a call! ☎️

.@RepSaraJacobs and I both represent Southern California and have some of the longest commutes in Congress.

And yet, we're here in Washington ready to protect our constituents' healthcare and reopen the government.

Where are our Republican colleagues? https://t.co/hHQEqwKtTr

From rising healthcare premiums to decreases in funding for local community health clinics, Republicans’ government shutdown is hurting everyday Americans. 

House Democrats and I are fighting to reopen the government and protect healthcare costs for working families.  

As we work towards a solution, I want to hear from my CA-29 constituents on how this Republican government shutdown is impacting you. 

📣 Share your story here: https://t.co/soAm5OHleE

Republicans have not been seen in Washington for 25 days!

For over three weeks, Republicans have been on vacation and have refused to:

❌ Come back to work

❌ Reopen the government (which they have shut down for 14 days and counting)

❌ Protect healthcare for working families https://t.co/iA6fONrNE3

The shopping portal for @CoveredCA is now live.

As you look at 2026 plans, you may notice your premiums will be more expensive in 2026 than in 2025.

Republicans are to blame for that – and they are not even here in Washington working to lower your healthcare costs.

Are your premiums expected to rise because of Republicans' shutdown? Let me know: https://t.co/soAm5OGNp6

Have you seen Republicans at work in D.C. recently?

I haven't.

For over a month, Republicans have been on vacation to avoid working on solutions that will lower costs and protect healthcare for Americans.

They would rather keep the government shut down for 20 days (and counting) than show up to work to help working families.

I’m calling CA-29 constituents who are directly impacted by this Republican government shutdown and rising healthcare costs.

I am going back to Washington DC to fight for constituents and their affordable healthcare, and work to reopen the government. Republicans need to do their jobs, reopen the government, and protect working families — NOT billionaires.

Share your story with me using the link in my bio—how has the Republican shutdown affected you?

Today, I joined Leader @RepJeffries and @HouseDemocrats in fighting for YOUR healthcare.

I will vote NO on Republicans' bill that guts the ACA subsidies that millions of Americans – including Stephen from Van Nuys – rely on for affordable healthcare.

Democrats will continue our fight to protect healthcare, lower the cost of living, and keep the American Dream attainable for all.

After 50 days, I can (finally) officially welcome the newest member of @HouseDemocrats, Congresswoman Adelita Grijalva!

I’m excited to have @Rep_Grijalva in the fight to protect healthcare, lower the cost of living, and hold the Trump Administration accountable.

This includes demanding the full release of the Epstein files and bringing the truth to the American people.

Vida Mobile Clinic has been providing free access to healthcare for people all across the Valley for over five years. 

It is because of organizations and health clinics like Vida’s that our community is able to receive the critical care they deserve without having to worry about the costs. 

House Democrats and I are fighting to protect access to affordable healthcare for all those in CA-29 and across the country.

I joined Northeast Valley Healthcare Corporation for their 28th Annual Holiday Toy Drive in San Fernando! 🎁

With the cost of living already being so high, the holiday season can place extra strain on working families. 

I’m thankful for our CA-29 community that comes together to provide families with the support they need this season. 

@HouseDemocrats and I are working to lower costs and make life more affordable for families in the Valley and across the country.
